author: Iron
body:
I realize that a few moderators saw this happen, and I do understand that that moderator(s) tried to solve the issue but he took it way to far. The video only covers the end of Obsi's rant. He started off by accusing others of "hacks." Then he proceeded to verbally assault me repeatedly. I will admit that I did fight back against him because he made fun of my friends and that is unacceptable. Just because we love a server and like playing on it should not make us targets for cyberbullying. To state that donating is a stupid cause and we all have no lives because we play mine-craft is just complete crap. He himself said no when a moderator clearly stated that he should stop being a bully. Also apparently he is the alt of "DaGoldBrick." The video really only captures the end of his abuse because before he "ended it" he constantly put me down with remarks that were completely unneccesary. Not to mention that he comes on teamspeak with a hidden name and eavesdrops on my friends and I.  

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jadmBtrJylE&feature=youtu.be
